title: oenothera mollissima subsp. propinqua
intro: Oenothera mollissima subsp. propinqua, commonly known as evening primrose, is a perennial plant in the Onagraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to alleviate symptoms of menopausal and menstrual disorders, and to support cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera mollissima subsp. propinqua include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and estrogenic properties, which may help to regulate hormonal imbalances and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), which is an omega-6 fatty acid that has been shown to have anti-inflammatory effects.
